title: Layered architecture
body: Architecture uses layered components and explicit boundaries. Retrieval uses a compact local index.

title: Retrieval design
body: Retrieval combines lexical matching with filtered semantic lookup for bounded discovery.

title: Supported tasks
body: Supported tasks include comparison, summarization, and traceable question answering.

title: Distributed architecture
body: Architecture separates ingestion, storage, and query execution while keeping evidence immutable.

title: Filtered retrieval
body: Retrieval applies source filters before ranking and returns bounded excerpts for review.

title: Operational tasks
body: Supported tasks include monitoring, classification, and concise evidence-backed reporting.
